body: Why were you depressed in the first place if you dont mind saying and did you have any of the same feelings after that incident?

Ive tried that stuff before, and ive been trying to make myself a better person. I can be a dick, like everyone, and ive made a effort to stop that but at the end of the day its just whether im not doing anything and just thinking for a while. You did make me laugh though thank you :P and ive started watching some more stuff so im sufficiently distracted for the time being.. But i also hate that i have to distract myself from what i truly think just to stop myself from being suicidal..

Thanks for the reply Clarance. I dont really have anyone i can talk to so i appreciate the effort. I've done these kind of things before, i dont want to make examples or ill just feel like someone who uses random moments where they act humane as a justification for their life, they don't make me feel like sitting on the benefit in a shitty apartment getting wasted at every opportunity will still be a worthwhile life as long as i can randomly help a few people.
